name: 40 new eighteen-metre missions with test7 policy_best_stage_3

selection.design_note: New fixed random panel with test7 policy_best_stage_3; previous results remain separate
selection.start_sampling: Uniform XY over inset map bounding box, followed by rejection
selection.goal_sampling: Uniform bearing in [-pi, pi); goal = start + distance * unit bearing
selection.initial_yaw: Independent uniform [-pi, pi); frozen in the mission list
selection.category_priority: 18 m: multiple_choices first; 6 m: surface_choice before regular
selection.regular_6m: Asphalt, ramp or gravel only; at most two terrain types; no qualifying alternative
selection.regular_18m: No ice/stairs and fewer than five cells or four terrain types
selection.surface_choice: No ice/stairs; >=2 direct terrain types and >=1.5 m rocks/obstacles; one-bend alternative <=1.8x direct length, >=1.08x direct length and >=1 m less rocks/obstacles
selection.energy_note: Surface contrast is a geometric selection criterion, not a measured energy ranking

path_note: Only endpoints are assigned to the policy. Alternative waypoints are selection evidence, never policy commands. No geodesic distance is computed.
